messages:
sam_prod: Quick heads-up — vendor just pushed an update on the APAC top-off. ~40 H100s showing a customs hold + one batch flagged for DOA. They proposed two options: (A) air-split two AWBs and expedite ~10 units (extra cost), (B) consolidate sea/air and accept staggered delivery over 3 waves. Need recommendation for customer-facing SLAs and whether we want loaner pool activation.

jia_infra: can you paste the AWB/manifest? also what’s ETA delta on each option?

sam_prod: pasted from vendor DM — AWB + manifest snippet:
```
AWB: SGG1234567890 / SGG1234567891
Carrier: AirExpressAPAC
Batch 1 (expedite): 10x H100 SN: H100-AP-0001..0010
Batch 2: 15x H100 SN: H100-AP-0011..0025 (sea/air mix)
Batch 3: 15x H100 SN: H100-AP-0026..0040 (staggered)
Customs hold reason: missing HS classification on one pallet (H100 cooling accessories)
DOA flagged: 1 unit from Batch 2 (SN H100-AP-0018) pending depot confirmation
```

maria_ops: thanks. rough numbers: air-expedite surcharge ~+$2.8k/unit, consolidation to sea reduces surcharge but adds ~7–14 days. loaner pool cost (overnight ship) ~ $350/unit/day. If we trigger loaners for top customers, ops cost will spike but SLA preserved.

andrew_vendor: @sam_prod sorry for the hold — we submitted amended HS code at 03:20 local; customs response expected within 24–48h. For expedite path we can split AWBs today and air 10 units for pickup tomorrow EOD. We can also issue a temporary loaner credit against replacement if DOA confirmed at depot. Pricing options: expedite = +$2.8k/unit; partial expedite + repool = +$1.2k/unit on avg.

jia_infra: from infra side, we can tolerate 7–10 day stagger on non-critical clusters if we enable canary routing and drained capacity to avoid cold starts. Hit list: region ap-southeast-1 has 18 spare H100 slots left — need at least 12 for production-critical customers. If only 10 expedited, we should prioritize customer tiering.

sam_prod: priority list attached inline: primary customers = Acme, Nova, Helix. Acme wants SLA <50ms 95p — they need at least 8 H100s immediately. Nova can tolerate warm-up for a week.

maria_ops: decision options:
- Option 1: Approve vendor expedite for 10 units -> allocate 8 to Acme + 2 to pool, boot canaries, enable loaners for Nova (cost share)
- Option 2: Accept staggered delivery -> no expedite, enable canary routing and lower cap for Acme (notify them of ~5% perf degradation), escalate credit claim for DOA
- Option 3: Hybrid -> expedite 6 units (cheaper), repool rest, request vendor loaner credit for remaining 4, and open claims for DOA + customs delay penalty

andrew_vendor: we can do Hybrid w/credit: expedite 6 tomorrow, repool 14 over next 10 days, vendor provides temporary loaners for up to 7 units for 14 days (no charge) if you sign updated SLA amendment for this wave. Also asking if Redwood will accept partial AWB consolidation to reduce customs friction.

jia_infra: if vendor provides 7 loaners, we can cover Acme and avoid negative customer impact. Need signed amendment for loaner terms and a PO addendum. Can ops confirm legal + finance?

sam_prod: finance + legal thumbs-up needed but ops already says loaner credit is acceptable if vendor covers RMA return shipping for loaners. @maria_ops can you confirm cost cap?

maria_ops: confirm: ops ok with loaner credit but vendor must cover inbound RMA shipping + depot repair if DOA confirmed. We’ll cap our prepaid expedite spend to $25k for this incident. Anything above needs finance approval.

ops-bot: New ticket created: #INC-2024-4821 — APAC vendor top-off / customs hold / RMA flow. Assigned to maria_ops + jia_infra + sam_prod.

sam_prod: next action items: (1) sign loaner amendment (we need vendor draft), (2) vendor to split AWBs and expedite 6 immediately (preferred hybrid), (3) vendor to confirm inbound RMA label workflow and who pays for returns, (4) ops to prepare customer comm for Acme (notice + mitigations).

andrew_vendor: sending amendment draft in DM and copying legal contact. Confirming expedite 6 units now, will post tracking in thread once AWB split is live. Also note: if customs clears in <24h we can reallocate two more units to expedite at same rate.

jia_infra: sounds good. once tracking posted, I’ll tag release team to schedule warm boot and canary routing. keep AWB numbers here.

sam_prod: thanks all — leaning Hybrid. Will loop in finance/legal after vendor DM. :thumbsup:
